about_the_game:
🧩 DLC Description – "Light and Darkness"

Step into the captivating contrast between purity and darkness with "Light and Darkness", the newest DLC for World of Art – Learn with Jigsaw Puzzles. This expansion features 54 stunningly restored classical paintings by world-renowned masters including Brueghel, Rubens, Gauguin, El Greco, Hokusai, Degas, Titian, and many others.

In this relaxing yet thought-provoking puzzle experience, you’ll piece together artwork that explores the eternal tension between light and shadow, good and evil, life and death. Themes include gentle nudity, mythological creatures, religious symbolism, and historical violence—designed to challenge your perception while offering a peaceful, meditative gameplay flow.

Crafted for fans of art games, educational puzzles, and mature storytelling, this DLC merges atmospheric visuals, cultural history, and single-player immersion. Perfect for those who enjoy deep, emotional connections to the stories behind the canvas.

⚠️ Note: Some images may contain mature or disturbing content. This DLC is intended for adult audiences only.

content_descriptors.notes: It is fine art that some may consider mature, scary, violent, sexual. But keep in mind that this still is a fine art that can be viewed in Museums. I don`t advise kids to use this particular DLC.
